data.title: bn-2yt: M0.7.1 ADRs: engagement, property and claim-template schemas

data.body: P1: target_version is optional here (and test_engagement_optional_fields explicitly removes it), but policy-rule.v1 requires target_version for every engagement source and policy_links rejects every non-null value when the engagement omitted it. The result is a schema-valid rule-bearing engagement whose own readers/writers can never produce a valid admitted engagement-source rule, so its findings cannot become verified without an otherwise-unrequired amendment. Either require a target version for a rule-bearing/final engagement or permit and define engagement-source admission without one, and add the cross-contract regression.

P2: inferred sources return before the shared citation range check. Because JSON Schema cannot express end > start here, an inferred citation with start 10 and end 5 currently passes check_contract, despite the ADR guarantee that a citation range is nonempty and forward. Validate citation ranges whenever a citation is present, then apply the admission-specific early return; add an inferred-citation regression beside the document case.

Fixed at ba7a7e9bb1f61ee28c5c0fe8dfb857ab6b1d148a. Target version is now required for every schema-valid engagement: schemas/engagement.v1.schema.json:173 adds "target_version" to the engagement required set (the field stays the version.* ref at :126). scripts/check-schema-contracts.py no longer deletes it in test_engagement_optional_fields (:392) and gains the omission regression at :408: (("engagement","target_version"), MISSING, "missing required field"). Against HEAD~1 that regression fails with Invalid not raised; at ba7a7e9 it passes, so omission can no longer produce an unadmittable rule-bearing engagement. docs/adr/engagement-schema.md now states target_version is required and why the cross-contract obligation lives at the engagement; the approved source table and the admitted-source target_version requirement in docs/adr/policy-rule-schema.md are unchanged. Evidence: just schema-check (11 tests OK) and full just check EXIT=0 at ba7a7e9.

Fixed at ba7a7e9bb1f61ee28c5c0fe8dfb857ab6b1d148a. scripts/check-schema-contracts.py:228-233 now reads source.get("citation") and enforces selector.end > selector.start whenever a citation is present, before the inferred early return, so document and inferred citations share the same nonempty forward rule; the admission-specific checks still run only for admitted sources. Negative regressions added beside the document case: inferred reversed start 10 end 5 (:499-502), inferred empty start 5 end 5 (:503-505), document reversed start 10 end 5 (:506-508), and the existing document empty start 5 end 5. All four fail against HEAD~1 logic with Invalid not raised and pass at ba7a7e9. docs/adr/policy-rule-schema.md Guarantees and limits now says the range must be nonempty and forward for every present citation, document and inferred alike, and records that JSON Schema cannot compare end with start so the local check owns it. Evidence: just schema-check (11 tests OK) and full just check EXIT=0 at ba7a7e9.

data.reason: Fixed at ba7a7e9: target_version required in engagement schema plus omission regression; citation range enforced for document and inferred citations plus reversed/empty regressions; just schema-check and full just check pass.

data.body: Precision correction to my previous note (no code change): inferred reversed start 10/end 5 is scripts/check-schema-contracts.py:500-502, inferred empty start 5/end 5 is :503-505, and document reversed start 10/end 5 is :506-508; the document empty case remains :509-511. Three of the four newly added cases are the regressions that fail at HEAD~1 with Invalid not raised (omitted target_version, inferred reversed, inferred empty) and pass at ba7a7e9bb1f61ee28c5c0fe8dfb857ab6b1d148a. The document reversed case was added for symmetry only and already raised under the previous document branch, so it is not a HEAD~1 regression. just schema-check (11 tests OK) and full just check EXIT=0 at ba7a7e9.
